# Discover Bangkok Prep
For over 20 years, Bangkok Prep has delivered world-class education to a diverse community 60+ nationalities. Supported by International Schools Partnership’s global network, our programmes lead graduates to top QS-ranked universities worldwide, including Oxbridge, UCL and Brown.

## A journey of evidenced success in Bangkok

Graduates went on to renowned universities worldwide, including Cambridge and Ivy League colleges.

In 2012, Bangkok Prep celebrated its first graduating class with Prime Minister Abhisit Vejjajiva as inaugural guest speaker, marking a proud milestone for the school community. Graduates secured places at leading universities around the world, including the University of Cambridge, Imperial College London, the London School of Economics, University College London (UCL), New York University (NYU), the University of California, Los Angeles (UCLA), Brown University and Cornell University, reflecting the strong academic foundations and global outlook nurtured at the school.

### Why choose Bangkok Prep

- Future pathways support Future pathways support Bangkok Prep students consistently secure places at top QS-ranked universities worldwide, including Oxbridge, Ivy League and UCL, empowered by the largest dedicated Futures Team in Bangkok and a proven university preparation programme.

# Bangkok Prep at a Glance
## Bangkok International Preparatory & Secondary School (Bangkok Prep) is one of the leading International Schools in Bangkok
### Now in to its 23rd year of operation (August 2025 - June 2026).
All graduating students at Bangkok Prep have been offered a place at the University of their choice and some of these are among the top Universities around the world, including: Cambridge University; London School of Economics (LSE), UK; Imperial College London, UK; University College London (UCL), UK; Lancaster University, UK; University of

Exeter, UK; University of Bath, UK; University of Edinburgh; British Columbia (UBC), Canada; Nanyang Technological University, Singapore; University of California, Los Angeles (UCLA); NYU-Poly, NY, USA; Rensselaer Polytechnic Institute (RPI), NY, USA;

## Secondary School
In Key Stage 4 (Years 10-11), students choose option subjects alongside a core curriculum, culminating in IGCSE examinations. Key Stage 5 (Years 12-13) sees students specialize in Advanced Level courses while also engaging in a core curriculum and receiving support for university applications.

content.text:
Bangkok Prep graduates mostly go to universities in the UK. Others go to the US, Canada, Asia, Europe and to top Thai universities.

**UK (the most common choice)**
- The school says graduates have gone to
the University of Cambridge, Imperial College London, the London School of Economics, University College London (UCL)

.
- For the Class of 2020, the universities with the most offers were
UCL, University of Bristol, University of Bath, University of Manchester, UAL, Imperial College London, University of Exeter, Newcastle University, Durham University

. UCL led with 12 offers, and Bath and Bristol had 8 each.
- The Class of 2022 received

87 offers from world-class Russell Group universities in the UK including: UCL, University of Edinburgh, London School of Economics, Durham University and 14 offers from Medical/Dentist schools across the globe.

**United States**
- Earlier graduates went to
New York University (NYU), the University of California, Los Angeles (UCLA), Brown University and Cornell University

.
- The Class of 2022 had offers from

Carnegie Mellon University, Georgia Institute of Technology, Purdue University, University of Michigan Ann-Arbor, UC Davis, UC Irvine, UC San Diego, University of Illinois – Urbana-Champaign, University of Wisconsin – Madison

.

**Canada and Asia**
- Graduates have been offered places at the
University of British Columbia (UBC), Canada; Seoul National University (SNU); Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (HKUST)
Nanyang Technological University, Singapore
, and the
University of Toronto

.

**Continental Europe**
- Listed outcomes include
BSP Business and Law School, Berlin · IST University of Applied Sciences, Düsseldorf · Lancaster University Leipzig … The American University of Paris … University of Navarra

.

**Thailand**
- Some students stay in Thailand. The school hired
the school's dedicated specialist in university pathways within Thailand
in 2023. One alumna mentioned on the school's site went on to
earn a BBA in International Business from Chulalongkorn University

.

**Popular subjects:** For the Class of 2020, engineering and technology was the most common subject, followed by psychology, computer science and business.

Most of these lists come from Bangkok Prep's own website and announcements, so they show the school's best results rather than where a typical student ends up. The school also says
all graduating students at Bangkok Prep have been offered a place at the University of their choice

, but that's the school's own claim, not an independent figure. If you're thinking about enrolling, ask the admissions office for a full, recent list of where graduates actually went, not just where they got offers.
